metadata.name: sbdemo.install
metadata.description:
(state, project='demo', url?, anonkey?) - lay down a worked Supabase example as sheet cels: config (sb.

.url/anonkey), seeded sb.

.todos.rev, sbdemo.

.status/live strings, and a reactive sbdemo.

.panel FormulaCel that renders auth status + live todo rev-count + subscription state via dom. The panel re-renders reactively as the handlers (sbdemo.signin/add/watch) drive the supabase verbs.

metadata.name: sbdemo.signin
metadata.description:
(state, project, payload) - dispatch handler: sign in via supabase.auth and write a display string to sbdemo.

.status (the panel reacts). Wire a button's click to this.

metadata.name: sbdemo.add
metadata.description:
(state, project, title?) - dispatch handler: insert a todo via supabase.data; the write bumps sb.

.todos.rev so the panel's count re-renders.

metadata.name: sbdemo.watch
metadata.description:
(state, project) - dispatch handler: subscribe sb.

todos to realtime; a server-side change then bumps the same rev cel and the panel re-renders live. Sets sbdemo.

.live.

metadata.name: sbdemo.ui
metadata.description: (project, email, password, status, tasks) - PURE render of the login form + kanban board as a vnode. Inputs dispatch to sbdemo.field; the button dispatches to sbdemo.login. Call from a formula with the reactive cels as args so it re-renders on change.

metadata.name: sbdemo.field
metadata.description: (state, cellKey, event) - input dispatch handler: write the <input>'s value (event.target.value) into the cel named by cellKey. Wires email/password fields to cels.

metadata.name: sbdemo.login
metadata.description:
(state, project, event) - login button handler: sign in with the captured sbdemo.

.email/password, then query the user's kanban table (RLS-scoped) and write the rows to sbdemo.

.tasks so the board renders. Sets sbdemo.

.status.

metadata.name: sbdemo.kanban
metadata.description:
(state, project='demo', url?, anonkey?) - install the interactive login+kanban demo: config + email/password/status/tasks cels + a mounted sbdemo.

.view formula (=mount('.origin', sbdemo.ui(...))). Real s + a Log in button, authored as a formula; on submit it signs in and renders the user's kanban board.
